title: Tab enters each view once and the arrow keys move between cards and rows
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at location "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" (on another site: the location named in the test run).
  • Technicians "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana" and "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ben" are active at this location, and both are pinned in your Board View (no other technician is pinned).
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Keyboard" has four Approved work orders: units "C97021-U1" and "C97021-U2" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana", unit "C97021-U3" led by "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ben", and unit "C97021-U4" with no lead technician.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" holding "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Keyboard", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off, browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record named above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click once in the "Search" box.
  2. Press Tab until something on the board shows a focus ring.
  3. Press the Right arrow key.
  4. Press the Down arrow key.
  5. Press Tab.
  6. Press Tab again.
  7. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  8. Click once in the "Search" box.
  9. Press Tab until something in the table shows a focus ring.
  10. Press the Down arrow key.
custom_expected:
Step 1: the cursor is in the "Search" box and nothing on the board has a focus ring.

Step 2: the focus ring lands on a card, the first one on the board (unit "C97021-U4" in "Unassigned"). No column header gets the focus ring on the way.

Step 3: focus moves one column to the right, into "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana"'s column.

Step 4: focus moves down to the next item in the same column, a card of "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana".

Step 5: focus moves to the focused card's own "More actions" (…) button, not to another card.

Step 6: focus leaves the board; no other card or column header gets the focus ring.

Step 7: Tech View shows the "Unassigned" group first, then "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana" and "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ben".

Step 8: the cursor is in the "Search" box and nothing in the table has a focus ring.

Step 9: the focus ring lands on a work order row, the first one (unit "C97021-U4" in "Unassigned"), not on a group header.

Step 10: focus moves to the next item below, the group header of "ZZAUTOTEST C97021 Ana".
